programmes.d: The Hedgehogs vacation is interrupted by the news of Robotnik's latest weapon.
On a mission in a distant sector of Robotropolis, the Hedgehogs are informed that freedom fighters have disappeared and are going to be robotisized.
Robotnik captures Bartleby and uses him as bait to capture Sonia.
When practical joker Reggie scares Archie with a Wolfman mask, his prank backfires!
One night, a bright, and glittering shopping mall mysteriously appears in Riverdale.
Government agents are convinced by Jughead's eccentric behavior that he is an advance scout for an alien invasion fleet.

To celebrate his birthday, Dr. Claw has Null and Void invent Kewpie doll bombs to explode on the moon and create the MAD logo. Quimby warns GADGET of Claw's scheme to change the face of the moon and instructs him to stop Dr. Claw.
With a black box controlled by his console, Dr. Claw schemes with the twin scientists, Null and Void, to intercept Metro City's bank transactions by manipulating their satellite transmissions.
With the aid of a time machine, Dr. Claw plots to go back in time to destroy GADGET'S ancestors in order to eliminate GADGET as well as bring back dinosaurs to rule Metro City.
It’s summer vacation. So many places to see… But Hilda wants the gang to go on an Adventure Tour in the Netherworld.
It is field trip time as Sabrina’s class heads toward Monument Island where an important statue is kept.
Sabrina agrees to help Maritza with her science project but oversleeps and forgets. At the witches’ academy, Sabrina and Cassandra meet a very frank magic mirror who insults and infuriates Cassandra.
While shopping with Sabrina, Maritza ogles a necklace that Cassandra buys. Knowing how much Maritza wants it, the unkind young witch uses it to taunt Maritza.
